title: Filmstrip 3D carousel

intent.caption: Filmstrip 3D carousel — An angled 3D filmstrip of image cards with perspective recession and one focused card; distinct plates, no echo.

visualSpec.effects: Five cards, each 1.6 x 1.0 units, arranged along x at 1.85-unit pitch, whole strip rotated -18 deg on y so cards recede to the right with perspective. Each card carries a DISTINCT photograph texture (base /prism-mock/home/nodes/parallax-stack.png plus four distinct variants; no repeated subject, no echo). Card material: map, roughness 0.55, metalness 0.2, clearcoat 0.15, framed by a 0.025-unit machined ink #16161d bevel. Focused card at x=0 counter-rotates to face the camera dead-on at scale 1.0; non-focused cards scale 0.92 with opacity falling 1.0 to 0.55 by distance. parallax-scroll intensity 0.5: strip translates x by 0.5 units per scroll unit while card textures counter-shift UV +/-0.04 for internal parallax. Snap-to-card on scroll end: weighted-settle 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1), overshoot 1.04 to 1.0. Focused card gets a #ff2a38 underline bar 1.6 x 0.035 units at emissive 1.3 plus its caption below; headline pinned at [-2.6, 1.5, 0]; body line at [-2.6, -1.5, 0]. All spacing on the 0.25-unit rhythm.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Scroll slides the angled filmstrip along x with 0.5 intensity parallax and UV counter-shift; on release the strip snaps to the nearest card with weighted overshoot and the red underline transfers to the newly focused card.

contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 body and captions (#e8ecf2 on #0b0b10 = 16.9:1); 3:1 large display headline
